breakdown.description: A transient heat equation is written while the problem is described as steady with no time dependence (equations/assumptions conflict).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly provided the transient heat equation (dT/dt = alpha d2T/dx2) for a problem described as steady-state. The agent correctly identified this conflict, removed the time-dependent term (dT/dt), and specified the correct steady-state equation: d2T/dx2 = 0. This aligns with the logic provided in the ground truth.
